meta.title: Academia for parents | Full academic monitoring, read-only
meta.description: Follow your child's attendance, exam results and notifications from one dashboard, read-only.

forParents.h1: Follow your child's progress, without watching every step.
forParents.sub: A complete academic dashboard for every child linked to your account, with read-only access.
forParents.linkingTitle: How is your child linked to your account?
forParents.linkingSub: One step done by Academia's admin team, not you, to keep the link accurate and reliable.

linkingSteps.d: Sign up as a parent with your email or phone — no details about your child needed at this step.
Academia's team links your account to your child's record and sets the guardian relationship type (mother, father, or guardian).
As soon as the link is set, your child's full academic data appears on your dashboard right away.

forParents.overviewSub: A single card with the four numbers that matter most, calculated automatically from real records.

overviewItems.d: Your child's name and school grade, shown clearly at the top of their dashboard.
Calculated automatically: sessions attended divided by total recorded sessions.
Calculated automatically from all exam results compared to each exam's full mark.
A clear counter for any new update about your child you haven't seen yet.

forParents.attendanceSub: For every session: the date, group, attendance status, and any note the teacher added.
forParents.examsSub: For every exam: its title, date, the score your child got out of the full mark, and the teacher's feedback if any.
forParents.readOnlyTitle: Read-only — a guarantee, not a limit
forParents.readOnlySub: A parent account is deliberately view-only: you can't edit attendance, a result, or any academic record through it — only the teacher enters that data. This protects the accuracy of every number you see.

report.d: Attendance rate, average exam score, and the session and result history in one report.

privacy.d: Parents follow but never change anything — the account is built for academic follow-up only.

multiKids.t: More than one child, one account
multiKids.d: Link your children to one account and follow each one on their own dashboard.

alerts.d: A clear notification counter on your dashboard for every update about your child.

faq.q: Can I edit my child's data?
faq.a: No. A parent account is for follow-up only (read-only) — this protects the accuracy of the academic record.

faq.q: How do I link my child's account?
faq.a: Academia's team links your child's account to yours after sign-up, and sets the guardian relationship type (mother, father, or guardian).

faq.q: Can I follow more than one child on the same account?
faq.a: Yes — every child linked to your account gets their own dashboard under the same login.

faq.q: Is there an extra cost for a parent account?
faq.a: Creating the account is free. Any cost relates to the lessons and courses themselves.

faq.q: What if I notice a problem?
faq.a: Reach us from the "Contact us" page and our team will follow up.

faq.q: How do I get a teacher account?
faq.a: Sign up with the "Start as a teacher" button, fill in your basic details, then complete your professional profile from your dashboard.
Your earnings are added to your wallet; you request a withdrawal to your bank account and the admin reviews it.

faq.q: Why isn't my profile in the directory?
faq.a: You must turn on directory visibility on the profile edit page, and your account must be linked to a teacher record.
Yes. Create your course (online or in-person), set its schedule and student group, and edit or cancel it from your dashboard anytime.

privacy.intro: Initial draft pending final legal review — written in plain language because it's genuinely about you.

sections.d: Account data (name, email, phone, role), academic data (attendance, exam results, course history), financial data (wallet transaction history only — we don't store bank card details, transfers are manual with a receipt), and basic technical data for security purposes.
To run your account and wallet, to communicate about your requests and notifications, to improve the service, and to comply with the law when officially required.

We do not sell user data to any third party. A student's academic and financial data is shown to the teacher of their course (limited to what's necessary), to a linked parent account, and to admins for administrative purposes. [TBD: name any external service providers — hosting, email, etc.]
Passwords are stored hashed, and login sessions are protected with secure cookies. [TBD: update with any further security measure once actually added to the platform]

terms.intro: By using Academia (and its related apps), you agree to the following terms. Initial draft pending final legal review — subject to updates.

sections.d: Using the platform means you fully accept these terms. If you are under 18, a parent or guardian must accept on your behalf. [TBD: exact age per local law]

Academia is an education marketplace connecting students with teachers and courses, offering an internal wallet, academic tracking (attendance, exams, results), and optional parent monitoring. The platform currently does not offer live chat, live video streaming, a native mobile app, or instant online payment — bank transfers are processed manually.

You are responsible for keeping your login details confidential. Available roles: student, teacher, parent, system admin. The platform may suspend or terminate any account that violates these terms or is used fraudulently.

Top-ups happen via manual bank transfer plus a receipt upload, reviewed by an admin before the balance is credited. Enrollment fee deductions are final once a teacher approves the request, unless a different refund policy is set [TBD]. A platform commission applies to each enrollment. Teacher withdrawal requests are reviewed before the actual transfer. [TBD: min/max top-up and withdrawal amounts, processing time]
Impersonation, uploading content that violates the law or intellectual property rights, unauthorized access attempts to other accounts or data, and any fraudulent use of the platform are prohibited.
Educational content uploaded by a teacher remains their property; the teacher grants the platform a license to display it exclusively to students enrolled in their course.

The platform is an intermediary between students and teachers and isn't directly responsible for the quality of teacher-provided educational content. [TBD: financial liability limits need precise legal wording]
The platform may amend these terms, notifying users of any material change a reasonable time before it takes effect.
